faq_q1_title: How to connect the feeder to the app? What preparations are needed?
faq_q1_answer:
1. First, connect the device to a power source and check if the indicator light on the device's control panel is flashing green.
2. Open the mobile app and bring it close to the device. Go to the app's home page, tap the "Add" button in the upper right corner, and navigate to the device binding page.
3. Manually select or enter the name and password of your 2.4G WiFi (5G signal is not supported currently). After the network configuration is completed, enable the Bluetooth function, and the device will be detected.
4. If the detection fails, you can tap "Scan QR Code" for detection. At this time, align the QR code on your mobile phone with the feeder's camera. The device will be detected successfully when you hear a "DI" beep.
5. After the device is detected, set a name for it. Once completed, you can view the connected device in the "Devices" section.
faq_q2_title: How to operate feeding via the app?
faq_q2_answer: After opening the app, tap the "Devices" button in the navigation bar to view your bound feeders. Select the feeder you want to operate, go to the operation page, choose the number of portions to feed, and tap "Feed". One portion weighs approximately 8 grams.
faq_q3_title: How to rebind a feeder that has already been connected when switching to a new mobile phone?
faq_q3_answer:
1. Open the app on the original mobile phone, find the device in the device list, tap the "More" button at the bottom right corner of the device, select "Delete Device", and then rebind the device in the app on the new mobile phone.
2. If you cannot open the app on the original mobile phone, press and hold the "Settings" button on the left side of the feeder's control panel. When you hear a "DI" beep, press and hold the "Settings" button again. After hearing the "DI" beep once more, you can reconnect the device on the new mobile phone.
faq_q4_title: Approximately how much is one portion of the feeder?
faq_q4_answer: One portion of the feeder is approximately 8 grams.
faq_q5_title: Can I connect the feeder with 5G WiFi at home?
faq_q5_answer: Direct connection to 5G WiFi is not currently supported. You need to switch to the 2.4G WiFi frequency band.
faq_q6_title: What other functions does the feeder have?
faq_q6_answer: In addition to the feeding function, you can view your feeding records of the last 24 hours on the feeder function page under "APP > Devices". You can check your pet's eating situation in real time through the camera, and it also supports functions such as voice intercom, video recording, and photo capture.
faq_q7_title: Where to view the recorded videos and captured photos?
faq_q7_answer: After opening the app, tap the "Profile" button in the bottom navigation bar. Once you enter the personal center, tap "Album" to access the photo album, where you can view the recorded videos and captured photos.

userAgreementContent:
Thank you for choosing LIVPET.
We are committed to providing an intelligent and seamless lifestyle experience for you and your beloved pet.

Before using this app and its related services, please take a moment to read and agree to our 《User Agreement》 and 《Privacy Policy》.

We value your trust and will protect your personal information in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Your data will only be used as necessary to deliver services, improve our products, and enhance your overall experience.

【Permission Usage Disclosure】
This app requires the following permissions to provide full functionality:
• Location Permission: Used ONLY for Bluetooth device scanning and WiFi network scanning. We do NOT collect your location in the background.
• Bluetooth Permission: Used to connect and configure smart pet feeders and other devices.
• Camera & Storage Permission: Used to capture and save pet photos.
• Notification Permission: Used to receive device status updates and feeding reminders.

Our Commitment:
✓ We will NOT track your location in the background
✓ Location permission is used ONLY when you actively use device pairing features
✓ All permissions can be revoked at any time in system settings

By tapping "Agree and Continue", you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted all the terms of the User Agreement and Privacy Policy.
